posts.en:
LiuHe#bundle is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Bridges the LiuHe MCP code toolkit (44 tools) into dsh web: repo_map, symbol search, edit_batch with tolerant matching, transactional edits with undo journal, and deterministic quality gates — backed by a crash-isolated Rust tree-sitter parse daemon and SQLite index.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-80c9192ca6642a2f2ec2.html
